verdict.rationale: Flagright's own REST API returns JSON-encoded responses. It documents read endpoints that retrieve customer data: the full consumer-user payload with rule results, batch business users, cases, alerts, and rule templates. That gives a programmatic way to pull data out in an open format, but there is no dedicated export or offboarding capability. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export feature, coverage of all data types (e.g., transactions, SAR filings, workflow configs), export file formats (CSV/Parquet/dumps), offboarding/data-portability guarantees, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
